An esteemed '''[[Carosite]] doctor''' went on a mission during the [[Galactic War]] and disappeared. He resurfaced more than five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, in [[3638 BBY]], without any memory of where he had been, and was thought to have been kidnapped.<ref name="MedicalEmergency">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Investigation|Medical Emergency}}</ref>
